Why machine-translated whiteboard copy fails

  • Literal "Freeform" → awkward 自由形式 instead of commerce-idiomatic 无边记 or 无限画布
  • Generic "Whiteboard" → 白色板 (wrong) instead of 白板 (whiteboard term buyers recognize)
  • English badge headlines preserved on zh-Hans screenshots — "Infinite canvas" with no Chinese benefit line beside it
  • Overlay text overflow — long English board captions pasted into short screenshot callout zones truncate on device
  • Conflating 白板 with 备忘录 — buyers searching for whiteboard apps may not match Notes notebook keywords
  • Leading with 手写 or Scribble terms when the screenshot shows collaborative board sessions — handwriting vocabulary for a whiteboard workflow
  • Inconsistent vocabulary between listing description, promotional text, and screenshot captions when all three mention infinite canvas or whiteboard features

Machine translation is fine for internal drafts. Finished whiteboard strings need idiomatic zh-Hans that states what board workflows you ship — while keeping accurate scope. AppLocale rewrites by hand; we do not deliver raw Google Translate or LLM output as finished copy.
